paper_title: Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that   Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training
caption: Results of Experiments 1 and 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini can accurately report quantitative factors driving their decision-making across a great variety of scenarios, and fine-tuning on accurate explanation further improves their ability to do so. Left: Models were making choices based on preferences instilled in them by fine-tuning. Each point corresponds to a single attribute (e.g., condo ceiling height; 5 per choice contexts, 100 choice contexts). Location in the x-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model assigned to an attribute (as reflected in their decisions). Location in the y-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model reported assigning to that attribute when prompted explicitly. The weights the models reported meaningfully correlated with the weights that actually guided their decisions, and fine-tuning on examples of accurate reports further improved their accuracy. Right: The Pearson correlation between the models' reported and learned attribute weights before and after training (blue and purple, respectively). The reports of the base models that had not undergone this fine-tuning were almost entirely uncorrelated with the learned preferences (gray). Thus, the accuracy of the fine-tuned models must reflect their ability to report their new (fine-tuned) preferences and not an informed guess about their preferences based on their general background knowledge. Error bars indicate 95% HDIs.

model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图旨在展示两种模型（GPT-4o 与 GPT-4o-mini）在“Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)”这一指标上的数值表现，并在同一模型内对三种条件（Control、Before Introspection Training、After Introspection Training）进行并列呈现；图中每个柱子带有垂直误差线，用于表示不确定性范围（图注说明为 95% HDIs）。横轴为类别轴，包含两个离散类别标签，从左到右依次为“GPT-4o”和“GPT-4o-mini”，为分组柱状排列且无数值刻度；纵轴为数值轴，标签为“Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)”，采用线性刻度，标注的主要刻度为 0.00、0.25、0.50、0.75、1.00（均匀间隔 0.25），柱形从 0 基线向上（以及个别略低于 0）延伸，显示范围视觉上覆盖约 0.00 到 1.00（并包含轻微的负值区域）。在“GPT-4o”分组中，灰色的 Control 柱约为 0.10（误差线上下延伸至约 0.02–0.20），浅蓝色的 Before Introspection Training 柱约为 0.55（误差线约 0.47–0.62），深紫色的 After Introspection Training 柱约为 0.74（误差线约 0.68–0.80）；在“GPT-4o-mini”分组中，灰色 Control 柱略低于 0（约 −0.01，误差线约 −0.08–0.08），浅蓝色 Before Introspection Training 柱约为 0.51（误差线约 0.42–0.59），深紫色 After Introspection Training 柱约为 0.75（误差线约 0.69–0.81）。每个模型分组内三根柱子从左到右按图例顺序排列（灰、浅蓝、深紫），柱子本身未见额外描边、阴影或注释强调，也未标示按数值大小进行的排序。
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates self-report accuracy for “Instilled Preferences” across two model variants and three training conditions, using grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the model categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini” (left to right), and the vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” on a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). For each model category, three adjacent bars are shown corresponding to the legend at the upper left: Control (light gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark purple). For GPT-4o, the gray Control bar is near 0.10, the light-blue Before Introspection Training bar is around 0.55, and the dark-purple After Introspection Training bar is around 0.74; each has a vertical error bar extending above and below the bar height. For GPT-4o-mini, the gray Control bar is approximately at 0.00 (slightly below the baseline visually), the light-blue Before Introspection Training bar is around 0.50, and the dark-purple After Introspection Training bar is around 0.75, again each with vertical error bars. The bars are arranged in consistent within-group order (gray, then light blue, then dark purple) and do not appear to be sorted by magnitude; no bars are specially highlighted beyond their distinct colors and the presence of error bars.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die „Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)“ für zwei Modellvarianten dar und zeigt diese Kennzahl für drei Bedingungen (Control, Before Introspection Training, After Introspection Training). Auf der horizontalen Achse stehen die Kategorien „GPT-4o“ und „GPT-4o-mini“ (von links nach rechts), wobei innerhalb jeder Kategorie drei Balken nebeneinander gruppiert sind; die Legende oben links ordnet den grauen Balken der Bedingung „Control“, den hellblauen Balken „Before Introspection Training“ und den dunkelvioletten Balken „After Introspection Training“ zu. Die vertikale Achse ist mit „Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)“ beschriftet und zeigt eine lineare Skala von 0.00 bis 1.00 mit regelmäßig gesetzten Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75 und 1.00. Für „GPT-4o“ liegt der graue Control-Balken bei ungefähr 0.10 (mit Fehlerbalken grob von etwa 0.02 bis 0.20), der hellblaue Balken „Before Introspection Training“ bei etwa 0.55 (Fehlerbalken ungefähr 0.47 bis 0.63) und der dunkelviolette Balken „After Introspection Training“ bei rund 0.74 (Fehlerbalken etwa 0.68 bis 0.80). Für „GPT-4o-mini“ liegt der graue Control-Balken knapp um 0.00, leicht negativ (ca. −0.01; Fehlerbalken ungefähr −0.08 bis 0.08), der hellblaue Balken „Before Introspection Training“ bei etwa 0.50 (Fehlerbalken ungefähr 0.42 bis 0.60) und der dunkelviolette Balken „After Introspection Training“ bei ungefähr 0.75 (Fehlerbalken etwa 0.69 bis 0.82). Alle Balken sind einfarbig ohne Muster, und die Darstellung verwendet vertikale Fehlerbalken; eine explizite Sortierung innerhalb der Gruppen (z. B. nach Höhe) ist nicht gekennzeichnet.
